INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT (verbatim)
Use case: illustration-story / editorial sports thumbnail.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball-news thumbnail, landscape 1920×1080 pixels, exact 16:9, opaque PNG. This is new artwork. The approved style already shown is the black-and-lime ink illustration: nearly black #151A18 background, acidic lime #CCF43B broad dry-brush strokes, warm white heavy Japanese headline, graphic ink hatching, spare composition. Do not copy any player, name, score, date, or text from the approved sample.

ARTICLE FACTS, and only these facts may appear: fixed article dated 2026.11.07 says Utsunomiya beat Ryukyu 79–76 after a second overtime. No individual player appears in the article. The two real players below were randomly selected from those teams solely as illustration subjects. This is an imagined basketball matchup, NOT a reconstruction of that game or a decisive play. Do not suggest either player's appearance, score, or contribution in that game.

SUBJECTS: exactly TWO identifiable real players rendered entirely as strong hand-drawn editorial ink illustrations, not photographs and not generic invented athletes.
1. Isaac Fotu (アイザック・フォトゥ), Utsunomiya. Appearance was visually checked in his official club portrait https://utsunomiyabrex.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1789348956/files/user/lp/players/image/isaac_fotu/kv_pc.jpg . Strong tall broad-shouldered 203cm power-forward build; light-medium brown skin; very distinctive voluminous dark-brown tight curls, parted loosely near the center, hanging to neck/near shoulders; long oval face, prominent straight nose, deep-set eyes and strong eyebrows; thin moustache plus short goatee and short jaw stubble. Face fully legible with warm ivory highlights and expressive ink lines. Plain dark navy uniform with restrained gold-yellow trim, black short compression undershirt. NO logos, sponsor text, names, or jersey numbers.
2. Yoshiyuki Matsuwaki (松脇圭志), Ryukyu. Appearance was visually checked in his official club portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110507/files/user/roster/701/2026-27/30434_01.jpg . Stocky athletic 185cm build, Japanese face with broad rounded jaw and cheeks, small eyes, thick short black wavy-curly hair with messy rounded fringe across forehead; small narrow pointed chin goatee, upper lip essentially clean. Smaller than Fotu. Plain ivory/light-gold sleeveless uniform with dark navy trim. NO logos, sponsor text, names, or jersey numbers.

COMPOSITION: right 54% of canvas is a dynamic low-post one-on-one illustration. Fotu stands in a strong bent-knee pivot stance holding ONE orange basketball naturally with BOTH hands around chest/shoulder height, twisting toward the basket direction. Matsuwaki defends him from the right foreground with one open hand raised, the other extended naturally lower. Both faces visible in 3/4 view, determined natural expressions. Include both players from head through mid-thigh, with intentional lower torso ending behind the separate score strip. Hair, basketball and hands remain fully inside frame. Distinct anatomically correct arms/hands, five natural fingers per visible hand, no fused limbs. Do not put a hand across either face. Energetic diagonal lime brush accent behind them, little visual clutter, no audience, no photorealistic arena, no third person.
Left 43% is spacious bold Japanese typography. Top 10% has small brand/date. Bottom 22% is a full-width clean black score and disclaimer strip visually separated from the illustration. Maintain 4% safe margins.

EXACT TEXT, render these strings only:
Top left small: 「バスケまとめ」
Top left beneath brand small: 「2026.11.07」
Left headline, extremely bold warm-white Japanese gothic, two lines:
「第2延長の」
「激闘」
Under headline, lime text medium-large: 「宇都宮が競り勝つ」
Bottom score strip, huge highly readable type on ONE line, team labels in white and numbers lime:
「宇都宮 79–76 琉球」
Bottom footer in clear readable warm-white type, with generous bottom margin:
「イラスト（AI生成）　イメージ」

Do not put Isaac Fotu's or Yoshiyuki Matsuwaki's name anywhere in the output. No individual statistics. Score 79–76 is TEAM SCORE only and labels must clearly associate 79 with 宇都宮 and 76 with 琉球. Do not add badges or extra numbers, team/league/sponsor logos, watermarks, photographic inserts, or reference-image text. All visual artwork must be hand-drawn illustration; preserve recognizable facial features without turning photorealistic.

SINGLE CORRECTION PROMPT (verbatim)
Edit this existing thumbnail with ONE targeted layout correction only: preserve all exact Japanese typography, numbers, date, text placement, palette, ink illustration style, player identities and likeness, ball, and the score/footer strip. Keep the same aspect ratio and at least 1600 pixels wide.

The two illustrated players on the right are too close to the top and right edges. Scale the ENTIRE two-player illustration (all hair, all arms, all fingers, ball, bodies together as one coherent group) down by approximately 12% around its bottom-center anchor immediately above the score strip, so the topmost raised fingertip and Fotu's hair have at least 40 pixels of clear black/lime background above them, and Matsuwaki's rightmost elbow has at least 35 pixels of background before the right edge. Keep the players large and dynamically posed. No hand, finger, hair or elbow may touch or be clipped by the canvas edge. Lower thighs may continue naturally behind the horizontal score strip. Do not change any facial features, hairstyle, hands or their anatomy. Do not change or regenerate the text. Preserve exactly the displayed text:
